text: Crashes every time I open the shelf page on my Pixel. Reinstalled twice. Works fine on my partner's iPhone apparently.
The text about the firing came at 9pm. The kiln was loaded at 6. What is the point.
Decent for booking but I still can't tell if my bowls actually went in. Status says 'loaded' for three days now.
Reserved a shelf, turned up, kiln was already full. Nothing in the app said it was full.
Notifications arrive AFTER the load deadline. Every single time. Missed two glaze firings this month because of it.
Our studio dropped it because $79 a month for 22 members didn't make sense. Shame, the schedule bit was nice.
Login loop on Android. Enter password, spinner, back to login. Support said to update, I'm on the latest.
I like seeing the firing calendar but there's no way to see how much shelf space is left so I just message the tech anyway.
Firing alert showed up the morning after. My mugs sat unfired for two more weeks.
Our manager posts firings a week ahead and the texts are spot on. Haven't missed one since we switched. Five stars.
Android app is unusable. Freezes on the reservations screen.
Would love to know before I drive over whether there's actually room in the kiln. The app doesn't say.
Got the text after loading AND it didn't show the kiln was full. Two problems one app.
Works but pricing jumps to $149 just to get texts. Small studios can't justify that.
No idea if my piece got fired. 'Loaded' isn't the same as fired. Had to ask in the group chat like before.
Crashes on open. Samsung S23.
The firing email came at 11pm for a 7am load. Nobody checks email at 11pm.
Reservations work well and the ready-to-collect ping is great. Wish the calendar showed more than one kiln.
Booked a spot, no indication the shelf was already oversubscribed, piece didn't go in.
Late notifications, again. Third review I've left about this.
Fine for what it is but per-studio pricing means our 18-person co-op pays the same as a 100-member studio.
Won't stay logged in on Android. Every open is a login.
